name: Spanish Factura
description: Spanish invoice (factura). Detects NIF / CIF / DNI, IBAN, Spanish dates and phone numbers, plus names, addresses and emails. Amounts are kept visible so line items stay readable — toggle 'Amounts' manually to hide totals too.

patterns.name: NIF / CIF / DNI
patterns.description: Spanish tax IDs: company (CIF), individual (NIF/DNI) or foreigner (NIE).

patterns.name: IBAN
patterns.description: International Bank Account Number, with or without spaces between groups.

patterns.name: Date
patterns.description: Spanish date: DD/MM/YYYY, DD.MM.YYYY or DD-MM-YYYY.

patterns.name: Phone
patterns.description: Spanish phone number: mobile (6/7) or landline (8/9), optional +34, not inside longer numbers.
